title: Functional Mushrooms: Unlock Health & Wellness Benefits
abstract:
### **Turkey Tail (Trametes versicolor)**  
Turkey Tail mushrooms are recognized for their robust immune-boosting properties. They contain polysaccharide-K (PSK) and polysaccharide peptide (PSP), which may support the immune system and are being studied for their potential use in cancer therapy. Turkey Tail has been used in traditional Chinese medicine and in modern practices to enhance immune health.
### **Boosting Immune System**  
Medicinal mushrooms such as Coriolus versicolor and Ganoderma lucidum are known for their ability to modulate the immune system. Compounds like polysaccharopeptide (PSP) and polysaccharide-K (PSK) found in these mushrooms activate immune cells like T cells, natural killer (NK) cells, dendritic cells, and macrophages. These components also modulate cytokine production, which plays a crucial role in immune responses. Ganoderma lucidum, in particular, enhances immune function through various mechanisms, including the activation of immune cells and their by-products like tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α) and various interleukins.
### **Reducing Inflammation**  
Several functional mushrooms, including Coriolus versicolor and Antrodia cinnamomea, exhibit significant anti-inflammatory properties. These mushrooms contain bioactive compounds that can inhibit inflammatory pathways, thereby reducing inflammation throughout the body. This reduction in inflammation can lead to decreased symptoms of fatigue, anxiety, and other inflammation-related conditions, enhancing overall well-being.
